brief_title: Effect of Exenatide on 24-Hour Blood Glucose Profile Compared With Placebo in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: Effect of Exenatide on 24-Hour Blood Glucose Profile Compared With Placebo in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Using Metformin or Metformin Plus a Thiazolidinedione

primary_outcomes.measure: Time-averaged serum glucose during a 24-hour period
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Every half-hour to hour for 24 hours

brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to test the hypothesis that in patients with type 2 diabetes, the addition of exenatide will result in lower time-averaged serum glucose during a 24-hour period, compared with placebo.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subject has an HbA1c between 7.0% and 10.0%, inclusive.
* Subject has a body mass index (BMI) \>25 kg/m\^2 and \<50 kg/m\^2.
* Subject is on a stable dose of metformin or metformin plus a thiazolidinedione.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subject has been treated with any of the following medications: \*exogenous insulin for more than 1 week within 3 months of screening, \*sulfonylureas or meglitinides within 2 months of screening, \*alpha-glucosidase inhibitors within 2 months of screening, \*pramlintide acetate injection within 2 months of screening.
* Subject has received exenatide, GLP-1 analogs, DPP-IV inhibitors, or has participated in this study previously.
